items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Because you know, Procope was his man.

ctx.x: So when we finished the first set, Kirby was so tickled, boy, he come and grabbed me around the shoulder... Because you know, Procope was his man. Nobody could do no wrong as long as Procope was there. And he was so tickled with me, because when Bill Beason had been in the band, he had tried to get me in the band for years, but I never would go with the band. So Kirby, he was tickled to death. He just put his arm around my shoulder, and he said, 'How much did I promise to pay you?' So I told him. Well, he'd…

I said, 'You promised me a hundred and forty dollars.' He said, 'You got a raise.' I said, 'Okay.' First time I ever got a raise that quick in my life. So he says, 'Come on, let's have a drink.' So he goes... Now, all you got to do is walk out the door of the place, and right next door is a whiskey store, and whiskey is cheaper in Washington than any place you know in the country. Just walk out the door, and halfway...not even halfway, right next door to the place is a whiskey store. Do you know he wouldn't walk…

items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: So he was working in this band at Small's Paradise, and they needed a saxophone player, so he came and got me.

ctx.x: Yes, yes. So he was working in this band at Small's Paradise, and they needed a saxophone player, so he came and got me.
And then you went back with Kirby.
